critical_code_review_comments: portal_routes.SharePayload uses Field(ge=1, le=90) for ttl_days but downstream only respects {7,30} via _ALLOWED_TTL_DAYS, silently defaulting other in-range values to 30. Consider tightening the pydantic constraint to Literal[7,30] or documenting the coercion to avoid client surprise (client sending 14 gets 30 back with no error).

SacoparentsPortal.jsx still at 1383 lines after the split — the 700-line guideline is exceeded. The container hosts modal JSX, reassessment/alignment forms, and every effect. Consider extracting the Reassessment/Alignment modals + effects hooks in a follow-up.

SafetyScreen.jsx uses <Link to='/safety-assessment'> from react-router but the modal is rendered as a portal-level overlay — clicking the full-screen link inside a flagged card leaves the state {flagged, safetyAck} owned by SacoparentsPortal in an unusual half-state (modal closed only when user navigates back). Not a bug but worth a guard-close on route change.

The 'first-visit' gate keys off localStorage.sacoparents_safety_screen_ack — signed-in users who clear their browser get re-prompted even though their portal state is server-synced. Consider also syncing the ack to portal state.

portal_routes._regenerate_share_pdf still runs a full PDF build inline in POST /share (called out in iter70 review). Not regressed but still worth a lightweight validate pass instead of full build for weekly.
